name: Power Gem
notes: A floor item (a red faceted gem). Only the player can pick it up: walking into it plays the item chime, floats '+10% POWER' over the player and keeps the boost until the run ends. Every move of the player does 10% more damage for the rest of the run, ground zones included (monster power_var). It lies at a random one of 9 spots each run (one per screen of the map, all reachable and out from under the tree tops, away from the start, the monsters' homes and the sleeping Alpha); the scene places it at the first.
